description: V8 old-space caps for review child processes and the review and fix daemons themselves. Child caps are twice measured peak RSS with a 1024 MB floor. Daemon caps (2026-11-02, 37 review and 51 fix passes) sit above heapTotal max 2297/2303 MB; the launchd templates carry the same flag and the host plists must be redeployed from them.
